analyst_view.overall: Atlético Madrid (23rd, 4 points) and Viking (22nd, 4 points) both need this to stay in the play-off places in the Champions League table. Atlético have scored too little lately, losing at home to Bayern and Barcelona, and Simeone admitted his forwards are short of goals. They are also without Ademola Lookman, out for weeks with a knee sprain picked up with Nigeria, plus defenders Cristian Romero and Marc Pubill; none of the three is in the numbers' missing list, so only Lookman's absence moves my view. Viking come in top of the Eliteserien on goals scored, level with Bodø/Glimt with two rounds left, and score freely (18 in their last 6), but they conceded three at Aston Villa and at Bodø. No referee has been named yet and I found no Viking injury news, so their side of the view rests on form.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals, 2.6 of them Atlético's. Lookman, one of Atlético's main attackers, is out for weeks with a knee sprain and the numbers do not know it; with the forwards already struggling for goals (the numbers' momentum only takes off about 1%), I trim to about 3.6. Romero and Pubill missing at the back gives Viking's in-form attack a little hope, which is why the cut stays small.

corners.text: The numbers expect 12 corners, over 8 of them Atlético's, as they should have most of the ball at home. Viking have won plenty of corners lately and the numbers already add about 4% for that. Losing Lookman changes who takes the wide runs more than how often Atlético attack, so I stay at 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.5 cards. No referee has been named yet, and there is no derby or bad blood here: Viking are a pressing, attacking side, not a cynical one, and the numbers already take a little off for both teams' recent card counts. Nothing I found points either way, so I stay at 3.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.9 shots, with Atlético on 21. Without Lookman, one of their most direct shooters, I take a little off, to about 30. Viking's recent shot volume is already in the numbers (about +13% on their side), so I don't touch their part.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target and already take 5% off Atlético for their poor finishing lately. Lookman's absence, which the numbers don't see, removes one of their better finishers, so I go a little lower, to about 10.4.
